title: SLSA Source VSA profile (DERIVED)
$comment: DERIVED from source-requirements.md 'Source verification summary attestation' items 1-6 (R-0118..R-0132). Applied on top of vsa-v1.derived.schema.json. Encodes MUSTs only: subject.digest present; resourceUri present; verifiedLevels contains exactly one SLSA_SOURCE_LEVEL_n (R-0127 'only the highest'); organization properties must use the ORG_SOURCE_ prefix (R-0130/R-0131) — expressed as: any value not starting SLSA_ must start ORG_SOURCE_ (strictly, the spec constrains ORGANIZATION-provided properties; SCS-own properties are unconstrained, so this pattern is stricter than the text). The level enumeration admits 0-4 although the item text lists only LEVEL_0..LEVEL_3 — see design-notes open question Q2. git refs fully qualified (R-0123) is checked as ^refs/.
